    Proposition 3.8: the faithful quotient of a brick string module is gentle #

    faithfulData is the monomial data on B ⧸ ann M(w) given by the vertices and arrows acting nonzero on M(w) (Step 1). Its relations are quadratic by seg_of_chain (Step 2) and satisfy the gentle conditions by the top–socle argument (Step 3, both halves done directly rather than by duality).
